modalities.evidence: T1-weighted anatomical and multidimensional diffusion MRI

output.population: Human; Healthy / Control; ages 18–28; young, naturally cycling female participants who completed 3 MRI sessions
output.summary: Structural and diffusion MRI from young, naturally cycling female participants scanned across estimated menstrual cycle phases, studying how hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal hormones relate to brain structure and function.
